caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt composed of numerous hexagonal patches arranged in a grid pattern. Each hexagonal patch consists of a central hexagon surrounded by a ring of six hexagons, and some have an additional outer ring, forming floral or geometric cluster patterns across the quilt. The patches feature a variety of colors and prints, including blue, red, white, pink, green, yellow, and brown, with many sections showcasing stripes, floral motifs, polka dots, and solids. The background between the patches is filled with light cream or beige hexagons. The quilt is bordered on two adjacent edges with an ornate, wide border featuring repeating floral and geometric designs in red, brown, blue, and white, with an additional thin border containing smaller patterns. The overall design is regular and tightly arranged, with the quilt placed against a plain, neutral background.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
